verdict.rationale:
incident.io exposes a documented REST API with per-tag OpenAPI 3.0.3 specs (open, machine-readable format) and webhooks that can sync incidents, alerts, schedules, and follow-ups out to external tools like Asana/GitHub, giving a technical path to extract data. However, there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature, no data-portability/GDPR export tool, and no stated support for full account data dump or termination workflow.

missing for 10: a first-party bulk data export/portability feature, explicit open-format full export (e.g. CSV/JSON dump of all incidents/timelines), and any documentation addressing account closure/data takeout.
